notes.title: Update 0.14.6
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, today I am posting the changes for the 0.14.6 update. This one is a little bigger than the usual patch so here is the changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Research slowed down by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Tanks are ~50% cheaper[/p][/*][*][p]AI is much more aggressive and dangerous[/p][/*][*][p]AI will now build tanks and navies more often[/p][/*][*][p]Graphical fix for strategic weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Small UI changes[/p][/*][*][p]Many bugfixes[/p][/*][*][p]Leader level-ups can now be automated on a per-character basis[/p][/*][*][p]Significant performance optimizations while looking at highly populated planets[/p][/*][*][p]Some projects have been rebalanced or fixed to match their intended purpose[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]NOTE:
I am currently investigating any crashes to desktop you can find- but I have so far been unable to consistently replicate the issue. If you experience any game crashes, please send me the save file at flomgusgames@gmail.com.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.14.5 & News
notes.notes: [p]Hello again. Today I am releasing the changes for the 0.14.5 update, but there are some other things I need to discuss first. [/p][h2]Future Updates[/h2][p]Updates are going to slow down for the next few months as I do not have as much time as I did over the summer. My main focus is on bug fixes during that time, but I am working on new content ideas and prototyping for 0.15, however it will take longer than with the previous updates.[/p][p][/p][h2]Politics Update[/h2][p]I have been brainstorming how to improve the politics system, but am not confident in any of the ideas I have come up with. As a result, I am asking you to help out: please, if you have any ideas or suggestions about this, put them up on the discord or email them to me, either way works. My plan in lieu of future innovations is:[/p][list][*][p]Privileges will not be customizable, and will be specific to each faction[/p][/*][*][p]Privileges will, like projects, be infinite but with scaling costs[/p][/*][*][p]Reforms will manipulate faction loyalty and privilege costs[/p][/*][*][p]Factions will gain extra benefits from having lots of privileges for every 5 "levels" of privileges.[/p][/*][*][p]Privileges [b]may[/b] be upgradeable and have effects on specific regions based on faction control[/p][/*][*][p]New Situations will create gameplay variance for specific countries and are broad enough to also represent other things like crisis mechanics[/p][/*][/list][p]The problems I have, that suggestions should seek to rectify are:[/p][list][*][p]Faction Privileges are too easy to figure out- their effects are static and obvious but there is little they can do to be interesting in the strategic sense.[/p][/*][*][p]Faction Privileges costing stability means they compete against other stability cost elements, but stability can already be spent on technology or conquest, making them comparatively useless or overpowered.[/p][/*][*][p]Faction Privileges are not cool enough[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][list][*][p]Units reinforce much faster[/p][/*][*][p]Units recover morale slower, and not while occupying enemy territory[/p][/*][*][p]Units cannot retreat into hostile territory[/p][/*][*][p]New ambient models will drive or fly around the map[/p][/*][*][p]UI changes to ensure compatibility with different scales and aspect ratios[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.14
notes.notes: [p]Hello again, this is the stable release of Update 0.14 for Solar Nations 2. These features have been live for some time on the Beta Branch but are now stable enough to be included in the main game.[/p][p][/p][h2]Immigration[/h2][p]People will now migrate from regions with low development and high population density to regions with high development and low population density. Migration happens both within and outside your borders, and you will need to deal with migrants by assimilating them, as they keep their old culture when they migrate, reducing you administrative efficiency.[/p][p]Migration can be increased with certain modifiers, as can assimilation.[/p][h2]Leaders[/h2][p]Leaders have been added to the game. They have skills and traits which can be assigned to jobs to make use of these skills for your benefit. This is the most unfinished aspect of the beta, as I have not had the time to make new icons for all of the traits.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//43760976/cd20ea2060f9829264be582494c175cb2f9e9af8.png"][/img]Here you can see some of the new leader positions. Notice that you cannot fire the Emperor- some positions have different means of successions. Republics, for example, elect a new leader every 10 years, and this election ensures that the leader of your country is probably also the leader of your strongest faction.[/p][p][/p][p]Each Leader has a certain amount of effort they can spend on doing different jobs. As a result, a leader can be both a General and a Governor, or an Emperor and an Admiral. This is done both in order to reduce the number of characters, as well as making the process of allocating characters more interesting.[/p][p][/p][h2]Culture Laws[/h2][p]Cultures can now be favored or disfavored based on whether or not they are of your accepted culture. These new culture laws include things like living standards, but the main effect is to make it so that you can try to remove certain cultures from your empire on a massive scale as opposed to needing hundreds of edicts. You could also choose to be nice to your subjects and shower them with extra consumer goods to keep them happy.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//43760976/d411d37b6d472cc872095c28fcf29a83f438afb1.png"][/img][/p][h2]Solar System[/h2][list][*][p]Planets now have their real life eccentricities and inclinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Saturn has been fleshed out with new resources and the Saturnian League, the most distant human civilization at the 2092 start date. [/p][/*][*][p]The Ice Giants have been given new resources, and their major moons have been added. In addition, [/p][/*][*][p]Pluto and Charon have been added to the Kuiper belt.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 0.14 Beta: Big Misc Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, I have been working on various things inside the 0.14 beta and will publish them now. There aren't any new mechanics, just a whole lot of changes and fixes.[/p][p][/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][h2]Hotkeys[/h2][p]Numbers 0-9 are now hotkeys for units and regions, and the topbar elements are now accessed using F1-F8 instead. You can use Ctrl+(0-9) to assign any group of units or a region to a hotkey, and can access them quickly at any time by clicking the previous number.[/p][h2]Solar System[/h2][h3]General[/h3][p]Planets now have eccentric and inclined orbits where applicable.[/p][h3]Saturn[/h3][p]The Saturnian System has been populated with new resources, and the Saturnian Federation has been added as the group of Titanic colonists. They have an interesting starting scenario, being all alone but with great opportunity available, as Saturn is bountiful in new resources not common in other parts of the Solar System.[/p][h3]Ice Giants & Kuiper Belt[/h3][list][*][p]Uranus now has some of its major moons[/p][/*][*][p]Neptune now has Triton[/p][/*][*][p]Pluto & Charon have been added to the Kuiper belt. More dwarf planets will come soon[/p][/*][/list][h2]Rare Resources[/h2][p]New Rare Resources have been added. These are very powerful, but also very rare and usually only found in the outer solar system.[/p][list][*][p][b]Helium-3[/b]: Jupiter & Saturn, useful for spaceships[/p][/*][*][p][b]Liquid Methane[/b]: Titan, useful for spaceships[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ice-9[/b]: Found around Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto, Powerful weapon, but also makes your population happier[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cryo-Organics[/b]: Ice Giants, Massive bonus to genetic material[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exotic Gasses[/b]: Gas Giants, General economic bonuses[/p][/*][/list][p]While these can be found naturally, they can also be found with surveys on planets where they spawn. [/p][h2]Units[/h2][list][*][p]Units are now much slower (experimental), specifically land units[/p][/*][*][p]A number of minor movement bugs have been fixed[/p][/*][/list][h2]Leaders[/h2][list][*][p]New leader editor[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI/UX[/h2][list][*][p]New planet info tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of small bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][h2]Colonization[/h2][list][*][p]Colonies take longer to develop, but progress is not dependent on amount of population sent.[/p][/*][*][p]Colonies now consume stability to maintain, but are monetarily cheaper.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Title screen now switches to other planets every 2 minutes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.13: Terraforming & More
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone. Today I have a major update for you all that I have been working on in the beta branch for a while now. For those on that branch, there is not much new to discuss, but I will compile everything here for those who have not been following the beta.[/p][p][/p][p]In short, 0.13 is mostly a refinement of existing mechanics, expanding technology and construction out to Tier 7 and FTL as end-game objectives; as well as new mechanics like Government Technical Integration and Terraforming.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Technology[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/82bbd06f6ac3e9f60c44776b51f4534de929b850.png"][/img]As you can see in the image, the tech tree has been vastly expanded, and Unity has also been given a similar facelift. Military Tech is now in its own tab, and it is much easier to find and specialize research according to your desires. [/p][p]Most technologies also incur a small stability cost, which is offset by researching Unity Techs, so they are both necessary for a balanced and prosperous society. In addition, unity can unlock new powerful government reforms later in the game, as well as making your interactions with factions bear more fruit. [/p][p][/p][h3]Tier 6 & 7[/h3][p]Technology tier 6 focuses on the implementation of Antimatter technology for energy production and military use. Tier 6 allows you to build Antimatter collectors, which almost exclusively can only be built in space, and create the vital resource Antimatter, which can supercharge your energy production.[/p][p]Other tier 6 technology includes Exotic matter, and Matter Energy Covalence, both of which are energy intense technologies that will generally require massive amounts of Antimatter to work. These inventions culminate in the [b]Warp Drive[/b], a marvel of engineering allowing spaceships to travel anywhere in the Solar System instantly. [/p][p][/p][h2]Space Stations[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/9f70da278a9ebf3ef2e308512c1beb50b43a5768.png"][/img][/p][p]Space Stations can be built in "Stable Orbits" which can be found in many places around the Solar System. They have special high-value deposits, and act very much like Asteroid colonies, except that they can often harvest Antimatter from local Magnetic fields, or have other strange and novel projects. However, space stations are cramped living spaces, and cannot have high populations.[/p][p][/p][h2]Government Technology[/h2][p]Government Reforms can now be integrated with some of the technologies you will research across your adventures. These can allow you to govern (& control) your population in new ways, and can also be useful for gaining more of the new resources (Robots, Neural Networks, and Genetic Material), which now have to be produced and consumed like Industrial Capacity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/a342120f9fb4beecc5885682b2d971972082aca6.png"][/img]Each Variant is slightly different than the archetype it represents.[/p][h3]Cybernetic Posthumanism[/h3][p]Cybernetics technology can be used to transcend your humanity in multiple ways, from neurological control chips to synthetic evolution. Embracing cybernetics will allow you to produce more robots, increasing your potential to automate your economy, and potentially evolving past the need for population altogether.[/p][list][*][p]Cybureaucracy (Bureaucracy) - Cybernetic bureaucrats with an all-seeing eye and programmed with extreme hall-monitor tendencies.[/p][/*][*][p]Homo Algorithmicus (Technocracy) - Macrocomputers with advanced algorithms synergize with neurological implants to accurately predict consumer behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Cybercorporation (Oligarchy) - Oligarchy of powerful robot-lords with cybernetic implants allowing extreme longevity and intellect; practically impossible to overthrow.[/p][/*][*][p]Cyborg Autarky (Partisan State)- Vanguard Party of Cybernetic Fanatics who rule with an iron fist.[/p][/*][*][p]Autoarchy (Autocracy) - Autocracy which takes utmost advantage of robotics to maintain control and obedience.[/p][/*][*][p]Cybernetic Consortium (Republic) - Republics which can wirelessly poll their citizens at any time using advanced neural interfaces. Definitely no ulterior motives![/p][/*][/list][h3]Homo Superior[/h3][p]Genetic Engineering allows for humanity to set its own evolutionary course, and in this case, you can do so to further entrench your power or to unleash the abilities of your population. Embracing genetic engineering will allow you to construct a new humanity devoid of weakness, or allow you to precondition your people for subservience, to create a brave new world.[/p][list][*][p]Techgene Oligarchy (Technocracy) - Technocracy of the genetically maximized; artificial supergeniuses created for the sole purpose of rulership.[/p][/*][*][p]Sequencing Bureau (Bureaucracy) - Gene counters that can use biological principles to pre-screen for dissidents and noncompliants.[/p][/*][*][p]Gene-Lordship (Oligarchy) - Feudal-Style oligarchy of superhumans who rule over normals with varying degrees of sadism.[/p][/*][*][p]Partisan Ethnocracy (Partisan State) - One-party and One-race, a system determined to expand the power of the genetically pure.[/p][/*][*][p]Clone Imperium (Autocracy) - Instead of traditional succession, the ruler has a large number of clones ready to take his place.[/p][/*][*][p]Genocracy (Monarchy) - Genetically modified super-families are able to keep their bloodlines pure through a mix of [i]circular marriages[/i] and genetic engineering.[/p][/*][*][p]Ethnic Congress (Republic) - Republic which uses genetic screening in order to determine the validity of an election. May include secret gene-lords.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Virtual Society[/h3][p]Reality is inconvenient, and with exponential increase in digital and AI technology, it is also obsolete. Use advanced neural networks to create elaborate false realities and achieve a level of control thought impossible; every impulse and desire of your population can be made to order.[/p][list][*][p]Techno-Absolutism (Bureaucracy) - Managerial Internet where absolutely everything has a DMV-style form to fill out.[/p][/*][*][p]Virtual Panopticon (Technocracy) - Surveillance Virtual society where everything is done online, and everything is being watched by automatic "compliance algorithms". [i]-1000 social credits, non-compliant thought registered[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Techno-Feudalism (Oligarchy) - Digital feudal society where you have to pay rent to both physical and digital landlords.[/p][/*][*][p]Propagandarchy (Partisan State) - Propaganda is inescapable in the metaverse- all will be required to spend 10 hours a day in state-mandated fun.[/p][/*][*][p]Surreal Patriarchy (Autocracy) - Virtual Society where the government has become so abstract and monolithic most people consider it effectively a law of nature.[/p][/*][*][p]Eternal Algorithm (Monarchy) - The Monarch is a widely beloved figure in this society, and everyone partakes in digital festivals honoring him every year! One wonders how he keeps his dashing looks after 150 years, but its probably not worth thinking about.[/p][/*][*][p]Cyber Democracy (Republic) - Reddit world. The worst government form of them all![/p][/*][/list][h3]Future Tech[/h3][p]Once most of the tech tree is researched, you can access new technology tiers 6 and 7. As part of these tiers, Future Tech allows for a true fusion of technological innovation to create stable and well-rounded societies with great powers. While technically stronger than the previous three integrations, Future Tech is more general, fitting a more adaptive playstyle; however, it is so much later in the tech tree, so it cannot be rushed, unlike its predecessors.[/p][list][*][p]Hobbean Leviathan (Bureaucracy) - Managerialism has transcened all boundaries, and now the state is indistinguishable from the society over which it governs.[/p][/*][*][p]Meritocracy (Technocracy) - All manner of hypercomplex mechanisms are employed to ensure only the best and brightest may rule.[/p][/*][*][p]Stellar Feudalism (Oligarchy) - A stable and efficient system of delegated powers, but consistent ideology, so much so that interplanetary distances are of no object.[/p][/*][*][p]Pseudo Hivemind (Partisan State) - Centuries of ideological conditioning have effectively eliminated all forms of unsanctioned thought, rendering individuality obsolete.[/p][/*][*][p]Star Empire (Autocracy) - An empire of such great luster that whole star systems can be encompassed inside it.[/p][/*][*][p]Transcendant Empire (Monarchy) - A system of lawful succession so fair and respected, it receives a great reverence from its subjects.[/p][/*][*][p]Minarchy (Republic) - A form of government so hands-off you might forget it is there, but society has moved past the need for micromanagement.[/p][/*][/list][h2]
Global Market[/h2][p]The market has been expanded so you can now trade Resource Capacities with other Empires. This will impact the price of these commodities, but it is a useful tool to make some extra money, or to fill holes in your economy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/e320054060719b6f261b7d0a60166e31902041f5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Missions[/h2][p]Missions are a new framework which allows you to complete gameplay tasks for rewards in a procedural and modifiable way. Currently, they are being used to represent Formables, Faction Missions, and Terraforming, but they have much more potential that will be expanded later. [/p][h3]Formables[/h3][p]Formable Nations will now show you progress towards the formation of the country (% of the population you control vs how much you need), but are otherwise unmodified.[/p][h3]Faction Missions[/h3][p]Factions will now offer you missions you can complete for Stability rewards. These are a nice way to gather momentum if you want to conquer lots of territory, but they can sometimes demand significant commitments in order to be accomplished.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/a61d2a6771ee5ffa5a7d185a67e9b6a77adc8d4a.png"][/img][/p][h3]Terraforming[/h3][p]Mars can now be terraformed in 3 stages once you command >50% of its population. This will show up as a Mission you can take in the Country Panel near Formables. This is a very expensive, but lucrative initiative which, once completed, will vastly increase Mars' population and economic potential. It also looks cool.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/04b6a71210abfc1c7e91cba9c621673d95e5b41c.png"][/img][/p][h2]UI and UX[/h2][p]I have made a number of improvements to the shading and UI graphics to make the game look overall cleaner. Most UIs have been touched-up, and there should be an overall increase in user-friendliness and niceness. Projects now also have categories that can be used to organize them when building.[/p][p][/p][h2]Saturn[/h2][p]The rest of Saturn's moons are now in the game, and Titan's oceans have also been added. These are still uncolonized for now, but the Titanians will be coming in the next update when I add functionality that will make them cool and unique.[/p][p][/p][h2]Future Plans[/h2][p]What I am working on now is a Demo, and then the 0.14 Update, which will contain:[/p][list][*][p]2025 Scenario[/p][/*][*][p]Saturn Politics[/p][/*][*][p]Politics Overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Characters[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.12
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, today I have pushed the 0.12 update, which has for some time been in development on the beta branch to the regular play branch as it is now stable enough for regular play. For those who are familiar with the beta branch, there is little new in this update, but I will take the time in this announcement to explain the new features to those who have not been following the betas developments.[/p][p][/p][h1]Military Changes[/h1][p]The cost of units has been reworked, as has their recruitment. Units no longer cost money directly, but instead are upkept through the construction of expensive industrial projects which give the needed resources for their recruitment. Units themselves have been rebalanced in order to make sure that there is a proper balance of power between different types of units.[/p][h2]New Unit Types[/h2][p]New unit types can be created with technologies unlocked throughout the game, each one brings something new to the table and changes the balance of war when unlocked.[/p][h3]Landcruiser[/h3][p]The new Headquarters component is very slow, but can be made faster to become a Landcruiser! These behemoths can be up to the size of an aircraft carrier and can serve many functions including logistics, support, and attack roles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Colossal Airframe[/h3][p]Airplanes are limited in the weapons they can carry, which sometimes reduces their effectiveness when coming up against boats or land armies. This can be circumvented with the use of the Airship, using the Gigantic/Colossal Airframe component. These flying fortresses can be massive, and even carry their own smaller aircraft, but their main strength is the wealth of components they have access to that would ordinarily be constrained to naval or space use. Combined with their fast speed, these war machines can be devastating even by themselves![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/56391443a357b91133d2053d1b836b0010ed79b3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Floating Fortress[/h3][p]Aircraft Carriers are big, but sometimes not big enough: when you have this problem, the Floating Fortress has you covered. Weighing in at up to 4x the size of a capital ship, they can bring enough firepower to flatten a continent anywhere on the 7 seas. However, their large size makes them vulnerable to torpedo attack, which means they require a large fleet of protective destroyers to distribute the damage. Regardless, Floating Fortresses live up to their namesake, and can be made incredibly durable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/f1dad673a8df1620d9dc0eecc9d392875aafd31c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Special Forces / Super soldiers[/h3][p]As you unlock new technologies, their military applications may involve replacement of limbs and genetic improvements- these can be made to any unit, but increase the cost massively. As such, there is an archetype of unit known as special forces, which are similar in composition to other units but far more capable. The primary use case of these soldiers is to break through heavy enemy defenses, as they can obtain higher breakthrough than any other kind of unit, reducing the enemy's advantage in bad situations.[/p][p][/p][h3]Strike Craft / Space Changes[/h3][p]A new addition to space is Strike Craft, effectively an analogue of the airplane, but for use in outer space. They are similar in size to their airborne counterparts, and require a carrier for optimal use, but they can deliver crippling blows to much larger vessels, and act defensively in a cost effective manner. As a result, they are a valued part of any space fleet.[/p][p]Space combat has been improved in general with the addition of new components to benefit Cruisers and Carriers, such that they will now be useful especially in the late game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/973ceb5cb7f2f4b3db085b4b0ad180defd2dc270.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Strategic Warfare / Ranged Attacks[/h2][p]A new capability many units have is that of Ranged Attacks, the ability for that unit to make a strike against a target at great distance, sometimes even across the Solar System. This capability also requires extensive command and control, so ranged units will generally require a carrier or headquarters unit to act as a controller. However, once properly set up ranged attacks can deliver massive damage to enemies who may not even be able to respond, allowing you to soften up enemy targets for attack, or devastate them with nuclear hellfire.[/p][p][/p][h2]Graphical Improvements[/h2][p]You may have noticed from the above screenshots, but units have received a facelift. Not only do they now include multiple models dependent on the total size of the unit, but units now fire component specific weapons at their chosen targets, with the strength and color of the weapon being based on the tech level in use. Now, you can inspect the enemy army to find out how much technology they have, or what weapons they are using. In addition, units will fire real projectiles at their enemies which can sometimes explode in spectacular fashion, giving more satisfaction to a well-earned victory. You can also now customize the look of your units by changing their color![/p][p][/p][h1]Economy Changes[/h1][p]As part of the changes to units, a new kind of resource has been implemented: capacities. These represent certain aspects of your civilization, but are very wide in what they can be. Industrial capacities are created through regional projects, and are often very expensive, but they are necessary if you want to build a powerful army or society. [/p][p]Their use is not only limited to units, however. Logistics capacity can be used on edicts, special abilities which can augment the economy of a region temporarily. Many capacities also have economic or political uses which vary with tech level and time.[/p][p][/p][h1]Politics[/h1][p]Faction Privileges have received a facelift, with the new ability to create your own custom policies and assign them to your chosen factions. This will give a greater degree of freedom to the player, while also increasing the number of options available, and you can mix and match these new policies to discover new strategies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/74ef0c320f9be23d07ebb4af8bc23d08f9da12f0.png"][/img][/p][h1]Diplomacy and AI[/h1][p]As part of the changes to the economy, diplomatic capacity has been added, which allows you to interact with other countries in some new ways. [/p][p][/p][h2]Guarantee Independence[/h2][p]If you are worried about a rival taking another country away from you, or otherwise just want to get in the way, you can guarantee the independence of other countries, such that when they are attacked, you will be called in to assist.[/p][p][/p][h2]Diplomatic Annexation (Make Proxy)[/h2][p]As you improve relations will like-minded civilizations, you can eventually diplomatically control them through making them a Proxy. This will effectively annex them into your country, but as a protectorate, meaning that it will take some extra work to fully integrate them.[/p][p][/p][h2]War Escalation[/h2][p]Wars will now escalate over time, resulting in less restrictions on weapon usage and greater likelihood of intervention by other countries. By default, wars cannot be intervened in unless you have +100 opinion with either party, but as a war escalates, this requirement will decrease until it ceases to exist. This means that if you have a little too much fun with nuclear bombs, the rest of the world might try to stop you.[/p][p][/p][h1]Polish[/h1][p]As part of the new changes, I have gone through and optimized many of the mechanics in the game to run much faster. Overall, I expect the performance increase to be around [b]~30%[/b] over 0.11, a significant improvement when accounting for the new changes. [/p][p]In addition, I have attempted to add polish to as many places as I could, with new hotkeys and intuitive changes to some of the UI to make things easier to navigate, but as always there is more to do. Currently I am investigating further UI improvements, so please voice any recommendations on the discord or via email.[/p][p][/p][h1]The Future[/h1][p]Now that 0.12 is finished, I have begun work on a new slate of improvements for the 1.0 beta, as I plan to for Solar Nations 2 to leave early access in August. The major improvements I plan on making are:[/p][list][*][p]UI Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Space Stations[/p][/*][*][p]Terraforming[/p][/*][*][p]Tech Tree Expansion / Rebalance[/p][/*][*][p]Saturn and the Asteroid Belt[/p][/*][*][p]Mission Trees (Maybe)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Beta Week 2: Military Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This week the main focus of improvement has been on the balance and expansion of military content for the 22nd century and beyond. My main problem with the military aspect beforehand was that military balance would not change significantly between the early and late game, so you would be using effectively the same tactics and army compositions throughout the entire game. It is quite unrealistic that there would be no significant advances in military technology that change how armies clash against each other- but at the same time it is necessary for the game to have constant rules, otherwise the experience can become too difficult to understand.

[h2]New Unit Types[/h2]
In order to rectify this problem, a set of new kinds of units have been introduced or expanded which should make things interesting as you reach the Mid-Game (when most of them are unlocked). 

[h3]Colossal Airplanes[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/53a8cdf686934abc41e392c7b878a57af00ea9ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/72ba8ad744233a09ca405aa9ba8c486b0a2e0e71.png[/img][/url]
Airplanes the size of a naval cruiser can be constructed and fitted with components that are more commonly seen in spaceships or naval vessels. As a result, they can have things like carrier decks, as well as railguns and other kinds of large weapon systems which can be useful for taking out swarms of enemy drones, as well as providing support to ground units. The only major issue with Colossal Airplanes is their vulnerability to massed fire from armor-piercing weapons.

[h3]Floating fortresses[/h3]
At 5x the size of an Aircraft carrier, Floating Fortresses can bring everything to a naval engagement. Their gargantuan size allows you to stuff them full of powerful auxiliary components giving them more attack damage and survivability than anything else, but watch out for torpedoes!

[h3]Super Soldiers[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/9c0e1838a740aa69bab4f55c40e4fcc8ad1337ac.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/8794872e0252e67dbca52d89bb7e525ef397efdc.png[/img][/url]
There are a number of new expensive augmentations that can be made to your infantry. Unfortunately, their price makes them prohibitive to have on your entire army, but Super Soldiers can be immensely powerful when used as breakthrough units, as they have comparable stats to Tanks with more breakthrough, but also more vulnerability to soft weapons.

[h3]Strike Craft[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/8869772065a05fae12ca19c97038c6c32cc8e840.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/08569f0cfc02275565b38781de1692a154640c64.png[/img][/url]
In Space, there are a number of new weapons, but the main addition is Strike Craft. Strike Craft are small, numerous, and particularly effective at dealing with low-armored spaceships like Destroyers. However, they suffer in the missile department, being both vulnerable to and unable to use them. In order to rectify this, use some Cruisers or a Space Carrier to provide missile cover and support.

[h3]Landcruisers[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/b253b547b753b41bd1d032caba8e6c96656030df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760976/3ffa0b15cdfdf7ad595ff0b621050d70f1921a9a.png[/img][/url]
The new Headquarters style land unit has many useful abilities, but is slow and vulnerable to enemy attack. The Landcruiser has no such weaknesses; it is fast (kind of), powerful, and can support a massive number of attached units logistically. Landcruisers can be built either for support or attack purposes, since they can be up to the size of a Capital Ship in water/space. Like their naval counterparts, they can include things like Carrier Decks, but also land-specific support companies like field hospitals. They are also uniquely capable of carrying large weapon systems in the land domain, which can be useful if you need to counter enemy EMP or need a Missile Defense shield capable of guarding 1 Million men.

[h2]Unit Qualities[/h2]
In order to make some of these unit types have their desired effects, Units can now have Qualities that give modifiers to themselves and the rest of the unit provided they are represented well enough. Since most kinds of units will give one quality or another, it is a good idea to have a nice mix of units in your army to take maximum advantage of these bonuses, which will also require you to invest in sufficient countermeasures for enemy stacks.

[h2]War Escalation[/h2]
This mechanic is already in the beta, but is not used as the AI did not build Nuclear Weapons. Now they do, and will use them when a war escalates sufficiently. You can block their attacks through the use of munition defense, but there are components that when used can allow large bombardments of Nukes to slip through your defenses. Be careful!

notes.title: Update 0.11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I haven't been making announcements for a while as I have been hard at on Solar Nations 2's new update, releasing now: Update 0.11. The main purpose of this update is to get everything ready for new feature additions and mechanical changes coming in the near future by fixing any bugs found by players as well as in my own testing, in addition to making necessary graphical and gameplay improvements which should help with enjoyment of the game.

[h2]Main update features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Tutorials covering basics, economics, and warfare
[*] Venus nations and formables
[*] Tooltip improvements
[*] Significant UI improvements, overall darker color which is easier on the eyes and works better with the bright text
[*] Map graphic improvements, including city lights for all regions, better regional display as well as an overall cleaner feel
[*] New Icons for government reforms and some technologies
[*] New end-game flags (Try forming the Solar Federation with different government types to see interesting things)
[*] Optimization and bugfixes
[/list]

These changes may seem small but most of my work in the past few months has been in the background,  preparing new mechanics for implementation and ensuring they will synergize correctly with existing systems. If you have any questions, please use the [url=https://discord.gg/n323WxPvpk]discord [/url]or [url=flomgusgames@gmail.com]email me[/url]. (Email is preferred for specific inquiries or detailed responses, flomgusgames@gmail.com)

Thanks and have fun!

notes.title: Update 0.10
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is the first major update for Solar Nations 2, and comprises mostly work that I had partially finished before the game's release. My main focus has been on UI and AI and whatnot, so the actual feature set of the update here is mostly consumed by bugfixes. However, the two important things that are being added are workshop integration and achievements, both of which should make the game more interesting and replayable.

Achievement acquisition should be self-explanatory, however the editing/uploading process for workshop integration will require some explanation; as a result I have created a guide on how to use the workshop interface tool, you can find it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3435858429]here[/url].

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scenario Editor Improvements
[*] Workshop integration (scenarios)
[*] Achievement activation
[*] Many assorted bug fixes (check the discord bug reports section for more details)
[*] Small AI powers now have/build armies
[*] General AI Improvements
[*] Unit optimization
[*] Balance changes for population growth, some units
[*] Many more tooltips
[*] Tooltip font size reduction
[*] UI improvements (diplomacy sorting, region sorting, and more)
[/list]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
I am now going to be working on content more often, but another one of my main concerns if graphics. If you have any recommendations, use the discord to let me know. 
[list]
[*] Re-implementation of Characters (they exist in the code but are inactive for balance/annoyance reasons)
[*] Espionage
[*] More space things (Space stations)
[*] Technology expansion (Tier 5 for 2400-2500)
[*] Unit expansion (Unit categories, resources for larger ships)
[*] Government/Ideology expansion
[/list]

If you want to be involved in the process of idea generation, the [url=https://discord.gg/n323WxPvpk]discord [/url]is the best place to be. 
We have a suggestions channel where you can discuss potential new features and improvements with the community!

notes.title: One Week Until Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I haven't made many announcements recently as the work I've been doing for the past month or so has been very lackluster, mostly bugfixes/balancing as well as some playtesting for AI behaviors. However, I am pleased to say that [i]Solar Nations 2[/i] is on track for its planned release day [b]Next Friday[/b], and I hope I am not the only one excited to see it finally come out.

I have been working on [i]Solar Nations 2[/i] for over a year now, and the process of developing it has had its own unique set of challenges as opposed to the first one. Firstly, this game is much larger in almost every respect than its predecessor, and as a result consumes more computational resources, requiring a greater amount of finesse in the programming department than I am used to. In addition, the greater number of systems has made balancing a bit of nightmare, and I have trouble exactly configuring the relationships between systems as needed to make them as enjoyable as possible. 

The advantages of these challenges are that they indicate that there has been a great deal of growth and development in between the two games, and so I am confident that this product will be far superior to [i]Solar Nations 1[/i].

On Friday, I will be livestreaming a playthrough of the game, showing the features that are implemented as well as the general playstyle the game asks for, so if you are unsure as to whether or not to buy the game, watching the broadcast would be a good way to familiarize yourself with the game mechanics.
